cualitativo.estrategia: Disciplined bottom-up fixed income approach prioritising high-quality credits and consistent risk-adjusted returns while avoiding weaker issuers and unnecessary beta exposure. Selection across both developed and emerging markets focusing on issuers with strong fundamentals, solid balance sheets and clear credit-improvement stories. Duration exposure kept flexible and responsive to macro conditions, actively adjusting interest-rate risk with both cash bonds and derivatives; derivatives also used tactically for risk mitigation and alpha generation. Managed by Fortune Financial Strategies SA (Geneva); base currency USD.
cualitativo.decisiones_periodo: H1 2025 gains led by duration and relative-value strategies (especially TIPS and European fixed income) and by financials in sector contributions. Tactical use of options across short- and long-term Treasuries helped preserve performance during the May repricing. In June EM credit outperformed broadly with Brazil, South Africa and Ivory Coast leading gains, while MicroStrategy's convertible bond was the top individual contributor. AUM increased from ~$130 million to ~$160 million over the first half.
cualitativo.contexto_mercado: H1 2025 was marked by elevated volatility, shifting central-bank expectations, geopolitical uncertainty and differentiated performance across fixed income sectors. A volatile January (Trump tariff policy, surprise soft Dec-2024 inflation) gave way to a February rally across the US Treasury curve (PCE 2.6% YoY). March volatility persisted as Germany's fiscal spending pushed Bund yields higher, pressuring euro-denominated bonds. April: IG outperformed HY on risk-off (US-China tensions, Fed leadership concerns). May: strong macro data repriced Fed cut expectations (75bp->~50bp for 2025), Treasury yields rose ~25bp, HY outperformed IG. June: return to strength, Sub-Fund +1.61% vs benchmark +1.53% and +4.50% YTD vs +4.08%; yields fell ~17bp on softer CPI (2.4%) and weaker payrolls (~140k).
cualitativo.outlook: H2 2025 begins with cautious optimism supported by ongoing disinflation and slowing global growth, strengthening the case for a more accommodative Fed with potential cuts as early as Q3. Macro environment remains fragile: geopolitical risks (renewed US-China tensions, Middle East instability, US and European fiscal uncertainty) and the potential inflationary impact of rising tariffs could reverse disinflation and complicate policy. With spreads very tight, selective name-picking is more critical than ever; the Sub-Fund stays focused on capital preservation, prudent risk management and consistent yield generation.
cualitativo.comentario_factsheet: Objetivo de inversion: proporcionar retornos ajustados al riesgo mediante exposicion directa e indirecta (via FDI) a valores de renta fija (bonos, instrumentos de mercado monetario, convertibles y CoCos). Gestion activa SIN referencia a ningun indice. Posiciones largas hasta ~100% del NAV y cortas (solo via FDI) hasta ~50% del NAV. Politica de distribucion: acumulacion (reinvierte rentas). Horizonte recomendado: 5 anos. Riesgo medio-bajo (SRRI 3/7). Lanzamiento del sub-fondo: 2024.
